blogs.title: The Importance Of Science In Everyday Life
blogs.description:
Since school days, science was a subject that held value. It comprised experiments, reasoning, and  most importantly, practical projects. It was exciting to participate in projects that aided our curiosity and created space for open conversations. Furthermore, the sub-groups of science, which are biology, physics, and chemistry, aided in the better understanding of the world showcasing the importance of science.

However, science extended beyond these classroom walls. For instance, cooking, travelling, communication devices, etc., have an essence of science in them. From morning alarms to evening entertainments, science surrounds us everywhere. It has been so ingrained in our daily lives that we sometimes don’t notice them.

Therefore, let’s learn the importance of science that surrounds us every day.

content.title: The Importance of Science
content.text:
Since school days, science was a subject that held value. It comprised experiments, reasoning, and most importantly, practical projects. It was exciting to participate in projects that aided our curiosity and created space for open conversations. Furthermore, the sub-groups of science, which are biology, physics, and chemistry, aided in the better understanding of the world showcasing the importance of science.

However, science extended beyond these classroom walls. For instance, cooking, travelling, communication devices, etc., have an essence of science in them. From morning alarms to evening entertainments, science surrounds us everywhere. It has been so ingrained in our daily lives that we sometimes don’t notice them.

Therefore, let’s learn the importance of science that surrounds us every day.

content.title: UNDERSTANDING THE IMPORTANCE OF SCIENCE IN EVERYDAY LIFE!
content.text:
Science answers our curiosity and provides us with the information of why things are how they are. It is a systematic study of the world done via observation and experimentation. For everything that science says, it has evidence to back it up.

With science as the foundation, the world is advancing with many inventions and technological advancements. Be it in the field of technology, medicine, construction, education, agriculture, transportation, communication, defence, etc., science has made the life of a man easier.

content.title: Diving into the applications of science in these fields:
content.text: Science has fundamentally changed numerous domains.

list.title: Agriculture
list.text: Earlier, the human effort determined the crop yield along with the changing seasons. And now, there are fertilisers and pesticides that keep the crop safe. Also, with the advancements in science, there is a decrease in the crop reduction rate and increase in the food availability for the population.

list.title: Education
list.text: From gurukul to the smart classrooms, the evolution itself showcases the effect and importance of science and technology. Nowadays, learning has evolved from theoretical study to practical experiences. For example, Nagarjuna Group of Institutions comprises different clubs and forums that encourage students to experiment with the things and think out of the box. The added advantage here is the access to information with vast libraries and digital connectivity.

list.title: Medicine
list.text: Medicine is a field that is solely based on science. The research and experiments done enhance the probability of saving lives in accordance with reduced medical errors. With innovation stepping in, the medical field receives the best equipment to provide better results. This change benefits the organisms to live a long and healthy life.

list.title: Communication
list.text: Science is breaking boundaries and bringing the world closer with the telecommunication devices. From pigeon post to mobile phones, this advancement contributes to faster information transfer in a more accessible and efficient way. It also connects the world better and aids in developing interpersonal relationships.

list.title: Transportation
list.text: With the invention of the wheel started the transportation evolution. In today’s age, one can easily travel to other locations, as there are lots of options to choose from. This advancement saves the time of the individual and influences the traveller gene of exploring new adventures and destinations.

content.title: Conclusion
content.text: With all the applications of science and benefits derived, it is safe to say science plays a pivotal role in developing the world and understanding the importance of science that enables us to contribute to the development. From the initial necessities to the ultimate standard of living, science influences our lives in every possible way. Besides the advantages, science also makes us live a curious life that explores the imagination and brings the brightest ideas to life.

callout.text: Science makes us live a curious life that explores the imagination!

blogs.title: New Year, New You: Start Your Year with Goal Setting!
blogs.description:
The year 2025 has already begun its course!

As we know, every year brings with it an array of hope and a vision of the perfect days ahead. This gives us the chance to realise our aspirations and design an adventurous existence. However, life’s unexpected turns might occasionally engulf us. Hence, let’s make this year a year filled with achievements and progress while also embracing the change altogether.

As we move forward in filling up the next 365 days of the year, let’s first visualise the life we want to build by creating short-term and long-term goals in this regard.

content.title: Goal Setting to the Rescue!
content.text: Start this year with goal setting and creating a life that you dream of. The importance of goal setting is that it gives us a clear vision and a practical breakdown of what we want to achieve and where our heart lies. This process assists in unveiling the desires in the typical manner and transforming them into workable strategies to move forward.

content.title: Firstly, let's understand what is goal setting?
content.text: Goal setting is a primary process that starts with listing down the aspects that we want to achieve. It includes the destination we want to reach and furthermore encourages us to plan the route to that destination.

callout.text: The more accurate the goals, the easier the road will be.

content.title: Here are some of the steps to consider while setting the goals.
content.text: Following these steps makes the goals and goal setter smart in pursuing their dreams.

list.title: Be Specific
list.text: Listing down the accurate and in-alignment goals creates a perfect vision board for the future.

list.title: Measurable
list.text: When listing the goals, remember to add a unit of measurement for tracking of the progress and understanding the growth made.

list.title: Attainable
list.text: Make sure the goals you write down are practical and obtainable with regular effort and focus.

list.title: Relevancy
list.text: A dream can be of any kind. But goals ought to be relevant to the current timeline and in alignment with the future you envisioned.

list.title: Time Bound
list.text: Assign a specific time limit for the completion of goals to accelerate the progress and accomplish the dream.

content.text: These SMART goals aid in having an action plan that consists of perfect ingredients for success and excellence.
As the resolutions are being made this new year, utilise these SMART goal setting techniques to create a fascinating story of adventures and achievements for the year 2025.

blogs.title: Exploring Virtual Reality: Top 4 VR Use Cases
blogs.description:
Do you enjoy video games? I do, too!

Have you ever wondered what makes the games so fascinating and compelling? Rightfully, the extraordinary characters, the visuals, the theme and the virtual reality experience. 

Video games take us on a journey to a world beyond our reality. It creates a space of pure excitement that boosts the adrenaline levels in the body. This experience is made possible through means such as TV screens and mobile phones, which have become an inseparable part of human lives nowadays. 

With advancements in technology and artificial intelligence, screen video games have progressed to a realistic experience with VR sets. Virtual reality has evolved from an adventurous trip to immersive involvement. 

Let’s explore this technology that envisions a world beyond reality and contributes to the existing reality.

content.title: Exploring Virtual Reality: Top 4 VR Use Cases
content.text:
Virtual Reality and its Usage in the Real World 
As said by Mr. Sukant Ratnakar, “Innovation is the outcome of a habit, not a random act.” 

Being innovative resembles an ability to create and renovate anything on the Earth plane and beyond. In simpler words, innovation is a tangible product of the imagination, perfected with constant improvements and additions. Therefore, the evolution of video games is a perfect example depicting the advancement in Virtual Reality technology.

According to Merriam-Webster, ‘Virtual reality is an artificial environment which is experienced through sensory stimuli provided by a computer and in which one’s actions partially determine what happens in the environment.’

In other words, Virtual Reality is a simulation that opens up a portal to the artificial world that is accessed through VR headsets and experienced through our senses in real-time. 

Here are some uses of Virtual Reality in various fields:

Usage of VR: 
1. Architecture:
“VR Technology acts as an ideal bridge between the requirements of the clients and visions of the architect.“

Virtual Reality in Architecture aids with the perfect planning, design and execution of the projects. With VR at play, the architects can provide thorough presentations to the clients regarding their ideal visions through simulations. 

With VR training, the workers can practice the activities in advance, enhancing accuracy, safety and efficiency. The advantages of this technology in architecture are

Easy understanding of the Structure & Design through Virtual Tours
Exploration of Design Specifics: Materials, Lighting, Structure.
Insight into Potential Challenges and Design Flaws
Implementation and Monitoring of Design Changes
Effective Communication & Decision Making
Instant Feedbacks

2. Education:
Education is an imminent part of life that completes one’s personality. With technology-integrated teaching, the impact of education has grown. It shows up through widespread knowledge and easy understanding of the information. It also enables learning and collaboration between peers sharing different perspectives and ideas.

Virtual reality aids in making the learning experience memorable as well, with fantastic visuals and immersive experiences while being in the classroom. Also, children with learning disabilities can grasp knowledge with VR sets and determine their learning pace.

3. Healthcare:
The healthcare career is one of the noblest and utmost professions in the world. Health professionals are impeccable in dealing with patients and curing their diseases to the extent of medicinal advancements. 

Virtual Reality Technology eases the work of professionals and acts as a platform for practice and improvement of skills. Some of the uses are:

Health professionals can learn autonomy as well as the usage of medical equipment through VR sets.
Medical Procedures through VR Simulations help to gain knowledge and understand the risk involved.
VR is used in medical device marketing to create innovative and engaging experiences.
Pre-surgical planning and emergency case simulation via VR Tech aid in minimizing the risks while prioritizing the patient’s well-being.

4. Entertainment:
Virtual reality technology in the entertainment industry enhances user experience with high-quality visuals and immersive interactions. It provides an opportunity to experience things in a new light. It also enables us to witness new dimensions and worlds impossible to build in the real world.  

For instance, the VR experience in Video Games instils a sense of adventure by transferring the users into a virtual world where the game continues as real-life incidents without any real-time consequences. 

Sony Interactive Entertainment LLC & Meta Platforms are amongst the leading VR enterprises that contribute to the advancement in technology and take care of the easy accessibility of it. 

With the usages discussed, VR can be the future of technology with artificial intelligence. However, excessive use of it can affect the mental and physical health of an individual. Some of the instances are disassociation from actual reality, an increase in anxiety and psychological disorders, effects on the eyes and chances of injury through VR headsets.

blogs.title: What Is Marketing? An Introductory Guide
blogs.description:
In the present world, marketing is an important and prominent aspect of business development. But have you ever wondered what is marketing and why it is essential?

According to the American Marketing Association, “marketing is the activity, set of institutions, and processes for creating, communicating, delivering, and exchanging offerings that have value for customers, clients, partners, and society at large”. This formal definition got approved in 2017.

In simple words, marketing is the process undertaken to introduce the company’s goods and services to the public. Market research aids in creating a buyer persona that enables the company to focus on the potential customers and their requirements. Thus, it makes the marketing process simpler.

Diving into the Marketing Notion
Marketing comprises all the activities from the start to the end of the company’s process. The marketing process entails everything from the beginning of product development to the extent of product distribution and customer satisfaction. It presents the firm with the direction to head based on research and analysis of the current market situation.

Marketers use the marketing mix to define what is marketing and determine the marketing strategies. One of the marketing mixes is the 4Ps introduced by E. Jerome McCarthy in his text Basic Marketing: A Managerial Approach.

The 4Ps are:

content.title: What Is Marketing? An Introductory Guide
content.text: Product: This represents the initial stage of building a brand or a company. The product that you develop needs to be a solution to the current problem faced by the public or service offered for the betterment of their lifestyle.

Price: The product price should be determined based on market research and analysis. If the price is too high, you may lose the market before establishing a mark, and if the price is too low, it will result in a loss even though the sales are higher.
Place: The place is decided based on the shopping habits of your target customers. The research aids in the selection of a place to market the goods, like online marketing or retail marketing.

Promotion: Promotion is a prominent way of occupying the potential customer’s interest in the goods or services offered. Promotions are done through advertising, either in digital form or through print media.
These 4Ps making up the marketing mix explain what is marketing in brief. Here each part of the mix is essential to excel in terms of marketing the company’s goods and services.

blogs.title: Generative AI: A Profound Element of the AI
blogs.description:
Nowadays, artificial intelligence is a prime topic of discussion in the fields of science and technology. This advancement in technology can be a boon that aids improvement or a curse that prevents further growth enhancement.

Different types of artificial intelligence support development in various ways, which unlock new opportunities and possibilities. Among these AIs, generative AI has captured a large audience in a short period. Also known as Gen AI, it can create and showcase a wide variety of data, like photos, videos, text, 3D models, and audio, with just a prompt presented by the user.

Let’s explore the nuances of generative AI!

content.title: Generative AI: A Profound Element of the AI
content.text:
Exploring Generative AI: History, Applications & Concerns
History: A View of the Journey
Generative AI isn’t a new notion; it has been around since the 1960s. This type of AI was first introduced by Joseph Weizenbaum through his creation of Eliza Chatbot, a conversation simulator. It showcased the technology that stimulated conversations with humans in solving their queries, developed using the SLIP (Systematic List Processor) programming language at MIT.

Further, generative AI resurfaced in 2010 with the development of neural networks and deep learning fields.

In 2014, Ian Goodfellow introduced Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), a machine learning algorithm with two neural networks known as generators and discriminators. The GAN model represents a competitive pattern between the two neural networks that enables them to learn and adapt without any supervision.

These innovations and advancements enabled the Gen AI to solve complex problems within seconds. Through this technology, one can create art or even generate an informational outcome with just a specification and a click.

Applications: Exploring the Positive Side
Generative AI is an excellent tool to ease the workflow. It generates high-quality results within a shorter period, which adds to the time-saving initiative and efficiency at work.

The applications of generative AI in day-to-day life are:

Chatbots for unruffled customer service
Template creations for email responses, resumes, and term papers
Refined product demonstration videos
Generation of high-quality art in the form of visual, audio, video, and text
Optimising the content, audio, and visuals for a realistic experience
Improving and enhancing the current industry standards
Concerns: The Loopholes in the Programme
Even though Generative AI has been an efficient tool, there are a few drawbacks to the arrangement that may affect the final product or cause issues like plagiarism, rights violations, and many more.

Some of the concerns are:

Inaccurate and misleading information
Information from an unknown source that minimises the trust and dependability quotient
Generation of fake news with the help of Gen AI
Plagiarised content that overlaps with and ignores the rights of the legitimate owner
Effects on current business models and algorithms working around SEO and digital marketing
These concerns can be solved with the upgrade of the tool. Therefore, technological advancement plays a significant role in closing these loopholes.

As interesting as the concept seems, it is just the beginning of artificial intelligence. blogs.title: Introduction to Chartered Accountant
blogs.description: A Chartered Accountant is the most prestigious title and certification that commerce students could hold. Hence, the procedure from enrolling in the course to successfully becoming a CA takes a long time. In an overview, this route takes you through three stages of achievement known as the foundation stage, the intermediate stage, and the finals. Following the second stage, the student must do an apprenticeship at a Chartered Firm as a practicum for future ambitions.

content.title: Introduction to Chartered Accountant
content.text: Every country has different sets of rules and regulations for pursuing this prominent course. Therefore, the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) regulates the CA Course and its membership in India based on the Chartered Accountant Act of 1949. This certification is only applicable within the boundaries of the country.
Chartered Accountant in India

Becoming a Chartered Accountant requires patience, determination, and dedication to the course. The CA course is five years long, with one year for each of the examinations and two years for apprenticeship. However, it can be extended dependent on the number of attempts you ought to make. 

Majors in Chartered Accountancy

We know the core subject of commerce is mathematics and accountancy, but a CA takes it to another level. These financial professionals cover every aspect of the financial market. It includes filing tax returns, auditing financial statements and business practises and providing advisory services regarding financial matters.

The focus of these professionals is on fields such as 

Applied Finance  
Taxation  
Audit and Assurance 
Financial Accounting and Reporting 
Management Accounting  
These fields define the line of work in which the CA specialise.
Chartered Accountants are called Financial wizards for their excellent ability to grasp interesting concepts like finance and aid in the easy-going industry process.

blogs.title: International Workers Day
blogs.description: Today is International Workers Day, a day celebrating the achievements of the working class, also known in many countries as Labour Day or May Day. It is celebrated across many countries and is a public holiday in India. The focus of this day is the working class. In recognition of the working-class contributions to the company, this day is set aside for them.

content.title: International Workers Day
content.text: Do you know how all of it began?

The history of this day dates back to the 19th century when the world witnessed the shift towards the industrial revolution. As the industrial revolution went on, there was a rise in demand for workforce personnel. This demand led to employment and the building of a workforce community. Later, as the number of workers increased, they were overworked and paid inefficient wages.

Therefore, labourers formed organisations to meet their needs and overcome the issue of exploitation. Many riots and marches happened to acquire better working conditions and lessen workforce exploitation.
Therefore, in 1889, North America was the first to declare May 1st as International Workers’ Day to support workers’ rights and raise awareness of the issue.
International Workers Day Celebration in India:

In India, the first celebration and recognition of Labour’s Day took place in 1923 through the Labour Kisan Party of Hindustan in Chennai. As it was the time of pre-independence, the main motive was to unite the labourers in the riot of independence and bring them justice concerning the workers’ rights.

Rewinding to the present, it is clear that the earlier problems with working conditions have significantly improved. We are in the age of information and technology, surpassing the industrial revolution; therefore, workers’ rights are one of the core components of today’s work-life balance.

Hence, on this International Workers Day, let’s celebrate the achievements and acknowledge the efforts put into the work. And also commemorate the journey of achieving the peak in working conditions. Now enjoy the privilege that bestows upon the working class now.

blogs.title: Padma Awardees from the Karnataka State
blogs.description: Padma Awards are the Civilian Awards presented by the Government of India. They are basically to honour the contributions made to bring progress and development to the nation. They have three levels of acknowledgment known as Padma Vibushan, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Shri.

content.title: Padma Awardees from the Karnataka State
content.text: Gradually, these awards apply to any field. These are acknowledgments provided for the contribution or service done by the individuals and groups that benefit the nation and aid in the process of development and progress.
However, it is a great honour to present these Padma awardees from Karnataka who got honoured and acknowledged with the awards.
Padma Vibhushan Awardees

Shri S M Krishna - He received this honorary award in Public Affairs. He served the nation as Chief Minister of Karnataka from 1999 to 2004 and as Governor of Maharashtra from 2004 to 2008. In 2009, he served as Minister of External Affairs of India till October 2012.
Padma Bhushan Awardees

Shri S L Bhyrappa – He is a well-known novelist and screenwriter born in the year 1931. He received the respectful Padma Bhushan award for his works in Literature and Education. Besides, the themes of his novels revolve around ancient Indian literature and tradition. And it also comprises a connection to human behaviour and emotions.

Ms. Sudha Murty – Is a well-known philosopher, educator, and people person. Also, she is known to be one of the personalities who believe in making the change rather than waiting for it. Therefore, her efforts at social work are acknowledged with the most honorary award Padma Bhusan.
Padma Shri Awardees

Shri Khadar Valli Dudekula – Is famously known as India’s Millet Man. In addition, he is an independent Scientist focusing on reviving five types of disappearing millets through jungle farming. And he is one of the Padma awardees acknowledged for his efforts in Science and Engineering field.

Shri Nadoja Pindipapanahalli Munivenkatappa – A brilliant artist celebrated for his extraordinary art of playing a hand drum. He is popularly known as Tamate Master because of his incredible playing of Tamate. Moreover, he started playing the instrument at the age of 16, ingraining the skill from his father.

Ms. Rani Machaiah – Popularly known as Ummathat ki Rani, Ms. Rani paved her way through the traditional folk dance of the Kodava District. She aims to preserve the traditional folk dance of her region from the danger of extinction. Therefore her efforts journey is acknowledged with Padma Shri, making her one of the Padma awardees.

Shri Shah Rasheed Ahmed Quadri – A personality from Bidar known for the Bidri Art has been honoured for preserving the art and culture of the region. This Padma awardee was born in 1955 into an artisan family, immersed in art from a young age, and later evolved into a perfect artist.

Shri S Subbaraman – This Padma awardee is a Retired Superintending Archaeological Chemist of the Archaeological Survey of India. In other words, he is an archaeologist. Moreover, he was honoured with Padma Shri for his findings in Ajanta Caves, Halebid Temple, and Afghanistan’s Bamiyan Buddha Statues.

On this special occasion of appreciation, we would like to introduce you to the Founder Chairman of Nagarjuna Construction Company Ltd. that is AVS Raju. He is an industrialist, writer and a profound individual. He was awarded Padma Shri in the year 2010 for his immense contribution in the field of Trade and Industry. Also, he has set a new Guinness World Record by writing the largest single volume biography – ‘Sri Sai Sudha Madhuri’ on the life of Sri Satya Sai Baba between 1996 & 2007.

blogs.title: Fiery Freshers' Day At NDC
blogs.description:
Freshers’ Day always marks the start of a new journey and a new adventure. The celebration of starting
anew and upgrading to the next level in the life journey is always special. This occasion becomes even
more pleasant and memorable when celebrated with lots of fun and joy.

content.title: Fiery Freshers' Day At NDC
content.text:
The Nagarjuna Degree College, in association with the Nagarjuna School of Management, hosted the
Best Fresher’s Party for the MBA Batch of 2022–24. This celebration started with a welcome speech by
the honorary principal, Dr. Harish Babu S, and continued with the dignitaries’ talk. The interaction
depicted that the goal was to welcome the students and accustom them to the college setting. The
speech was comprised of a warm gesture to welcome the students and a little peek into the academic
section with the focus on the future.

Following the speeches, the stage was taken over by the seniors. The seniors had planned the whole day
with different and unique activities to keep the audience, especially the juniors, engaged. Therefore, the
audiences witnessed some of the phenomenal performances enacted by the seniors on the occasion of
fresher’s day. The enjoyment meter in the amphitheatre of the college was high, as the audience’s
cheers were getting louder because of excitement and joy.

The seniors had also prepared several games for their beloved juniors as a part of the function. The
students participated in the games wholeheartedly and enjoyed their time on Fresher’s Day. An
awesome day concluded with some refreshments, and students returned with warm smiles and hearts
filled with happiness.
